title: 第64章 舌吻受害者
content_zh:
第64章 舌吻受害者-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

上一章

存书签

下一章

玩过《仙剑三》游戏的人都知道，游戏主角名字全是药材。

徐长卿便是一种药材。

它有极高的药用价值，具有清热解毒功效。

解的什么毒？

蛇毒。

只有他才能解女娲的三世情毒。

和后世情情爱爱只为自己不一样，《仙剑三》讲究的是舍小家为大家，天下苍生永远高于儿女私情。

上辈子魏沐做吐槽视频博主，经常喜欢拿《仙剑一》和《仙剑三》的台词和立意吊打那些只知道谈情说爱的烂戏。

以前的电视剧：我为天下苍生，舍弃儿女私情

未来的电视剧：天下苍生关我屁事，我要谈恋爱

原版徐长卿妆造还行，先不提横店炮王演技如何。

至少他的扮相确实适合仙风道骨的白衣修士，否则李国立导演也不会三顾茅顾找他演戏。

他最大的缺点就是矮，目测没有175，而与她搭档演戏的女演员糖嫣则有172。

一些八卦杂志透露，霍健华每次演戏都要往鞋里面塞垫子......

魏沐裸足183，穿上鞋子185，看着比胡哥还高一点，配合糖嫣演戏毫无压力。

这是他的优点之一。

除此之外还有台词，口音是湾湾男演员的通病。

君不见有些宝岛演员在内地混了十几年，口音还是老样子....

真的因为很难改吗？

霍健华的普通话还算标准，但跟魏沐比不了。

原主可是上戏表演专业毕业生，再加上他上辈子多年演戏经验，台词方面足以碾压同龄演员。

........

“剑本凡铁，因执拿而通灵，因心而动，因血而活.......”

念了一大段台词后，助理喊“咔”

导演李国立从监视器后面探出头，向魏沐比了个拇指。

“演得不错。”

电视剧中，徐长卿身为蜀山弟子，正派人士，大道理一堆，因此有不少拗口台词。

原时空，有的时候霍健华背不下来，只能说12345，后期靠配音。

现在换成魏沐来演，脱口而出，就是背台词麻烦，索性他记性不错。

“老魏。你们上戏教学水平不错啊。”

下了戏，站在旁边看热闹的大幂幂凑上来。

“呵呵。你们北电也不差啊。”

“切.....你给我的感觉不像上戏学生，上戏出来的都有一股话剧味...”

这话说的有些刻板印象，魔都话剧艺术中心在国内非常有名，里面确实有不少上戏出来的学生。

但要说全是话剧味.....没那么严重。

“你们北电不是出明星吗？中戏出演员，否则北电那么多知名导演为什么偏偏要去中戏找演员...”

Anyone who has played the game "Sword and Sword III" knows that the names of the protagonists in the game are all medicinal materials.

Xu Changqing is a kind of medicinal material.

It has extremely high medicinal value and has the effect of clearing away heat and detoxifying.

What poison was cured?

Snake venom.

Only he can relieve Nuwa's three-life love poison.

Unlike in later generations, love and love are only for oneself, "Sword and Sword III" emphasizes the importance of sacrificing the small family for everyone, and the common people in the world are always higher than the personal love of children.

In his previous life, Wei Mu was a complaining video blogger. He often liked to use the lines and ideas of "Sword of Sword One" and "Sword of Sword Three" to criticize those bad dramas that only focused on romance.

Previous TV series: I gave up my children’s personal love for the sake of the world

Future TV series: The world is none of my business, I want to fall in love

Xu Changqing's makeup in the original version is okay, let's not talk about Hengdian Gun King's acting skills.

At least his appearance is indeed suitable for a white monk with an immortal style, otherwise director Li Guoli would not have looked at Mao Gu to find him to act.

His biggest shortcoming is that he is short. He is not 175 by visual inspection, but his co-star, Tang Yan, is 172.

Some gossip magazines revealed that Huo Jianhua had to stuff cushions into his shoes every time he acted...

Wei Mu's bare feet are 183cm, and with shoes on she is 185cm. She looks a little taller than Brother Hu, and there is no pressure to act with Tang Yan.

This is one of his strengths.

In addition to the lines, the accent is a common problem among Wanwan actors.

Didn’t you see that some Baodao actors have been working in the Mainland for more than ten years, but their accents are still the same...

Is it really because it’s difficult to change?

Huo Jianhua's Mandarin is pretty good, but it's not as good as Wei Mu's.

The original owner is a graduate majoring in theater performance. Coupled with his many years of acting experience in his previous life, he can crush actors of the same age in terms of lines.

........

"The sword is made of iron, but it communicates with the spirit by holding it, moves by the heart, and lives by the blood..."

After reading a long section of lines, the assistant shouted "Ka"

Director Li Guoli poked his head out from behind the monitor and gave Wei Mu a thumbs up.

"Well done."

In the TV series, Xu Changqing is a disciple of Shushan, a decent person, and has a lot of great principles, so he has many awkward lines.

Sometimes Huo Jianhua couldn't memorize the original time and space, so he could only say 12345, and later relied on dubbing.

Now it is Wei Mu who plays the role. He blurts out the words, but it is troublesome to memorize the lines. He simply has a good memory.

"Old Wei. Your theater teaching skills are pretty good."

After the show, Da Mi Mi, who was standing by and watching the fun, came up.

"Haha. You Nortel are not bad either."

"Tch...you don't feel like a theater student to me. Everyone who comes out of a theater has a sense of drama..."

This is a bit of a stereotype. The Magic City Dramatic Arts Center is very famous in China, and there are indeed many students in it who have come out of theater.

But to say it's all drama... it's not that serious.

"Don't you, Nortel, produce stars? China Opera produces actors. Otherwise, why would so many well-known directors from Nortel go to China Theater to find actors..."
